# Meld pairs

Converted text of two meld pairs, copied unchanged from a whole-corpus conversion at commit ae8e852d
(`python -m price_predictor convert`). In each pair both halves print the melded face as their second
face; only the holder's first face says "meld them into <face>". Read by
`tests/unit/scripts/test_rules_catalogue.py` (task A24). Refresh them from a new conversion when the
converter's output for these cards changes.
